Billing totals use the invoice billing month, including final invoices. Drafts and void invoices are excluded. Payments use their payment date and exclude voided payments.
Balances, invoice statuses, occupancy and refunds show the latest saved position, not a historical month-end snapshot. Overdue means the due calendar date has passed in Cambodia.

Understand how your records are handled

Rental and billing records are stored in Android’s private app storage. Core workflows work offline.

Backups are password protected and saved only when you choose a destination. Device preferences and notification delivery history are not included. There is no automatic cloud upload or synchronization.

Restore replaces current records after validation and confirmation. Save a fresh backup first.

Invoices are shared only after you choose Share and select a receiving app.

Uninstalling RoomKit or clearing app storage can remove local records. Keep your backup and password safe.
A clear finish to each billing month
Keep a protected copy of your records

No automatic upload. Keep your password separately; RoomKit cannot recover it.

Confirm that draft charges have been reviewed. Eligible ongoing tenancies are billed together. Ended tenancies use move-out settlements. Missing readings or unresolved drafts stop the close without partial changes.
